title: Universal plant and animal eDNA metabarcoding using Nanopore sequencing
author: Lucas Esteban Wange
materials: Discard the supernatant using a P1000 pipette
Air-dry beads for 5 min on the magnet.
Typically we aim for 300 fmol total input
Start the BioScanRT pipeline as sepcified in github

steps.title: Prepare Proteinase K Storage Buffer
steps.instruction: Add 1,040 µl Proteinase K Storage Buffer to each Proteinase K (20 mg) tube. Mix and store at -20ºC.

steps.title: Sample Homogenization and Lysis
steps.instruction: Mechanically homogenize the sample and perform enzymatic lysis.

substeps.instruction: Add up to 50 mg of material to a bead beating tube containing DNA/RNA Shield.
Homogenize on a vortex mixer at maximum speed for 3 minutes.
Add 20 µl Proteinase K, mix well, and incubate at room temperature (RT) for 30 min.
Centrifuge at 10,000 x g for 1 min to pellet debris.
Transfer up to 400 µl of lysate into a new tube.

steps.title: DNA Extraction via Magnetic Beads
steps.instruction: Extract DNA using MagBinding beads and sequential washes.

substeps.instruction: Add 400 µl Quick-DNA MagBinding Buffer to 400 µl digested sample; mix by pipetting or inverting 10 times.
Add 33 µl of MagBinding Beads (or 30 µl if using a repeater pipette).
Place on magnetic rack until beads separate from solution.
Remove from rack, add 500 µl Quick-DNA MagBinding Buffer, and mix.
Return to magnetic rack, wait for separation, and discard supernatant using a P1000 pipette.
Remove from rack, add 500 µl DNA Pre-Wash Buffer, and mix by pipetting.
Return to magnetic rack, wait for separation, and discard supernatant using a P1000 pipette.
Remove from rack, add 900 µl g-DNA Wash Buffer, and mix by pipetting.
Return to magnetic rack, wait for separation, and discard supernatant using a P1000 pipette.
Repeat the last wash step (adding g-DNA Wash Buffer and discarding supernatant) two more times.
Add 40 µl of DNA Elution Buffer to each sample.
Place on magnetic rack until beads separate, then transfer the eluted DNA to a new tube.

steps.title: Multiplex PCR Amplification
steps.instruction: Perform barcode-specific PCR amplification of target regions.

substeps.instruction: Add 19.5 µl eDNA to one well per sample (6.5 µl per technical triplicate).
Add 30 µl 2x Qiagen Multiplex PCR mix to each well.
Mix with a multichannel pipette and distribute 16.5 µl into 3 wells per sample.
Seal microwell plates with thick plastic seals (e.g., MicroAmp clear Adhesive Film).
Set up NTC (10 µl 2x Qiagen Multiplex PCR mix, 6.5 µl H2O) and Positive Control (10 µl 2x Qiagen Multiplex PCR mix, 6.5 µl diluted control DNA, max 1 ng total).
Add 3.5 µl of forward reverse barcode mix per well (or 1.75 µl each of forward and reverse mix).
Run PCR cycling: Initial denaturation 95ºC for 15m; 35 cycles of [95ºC 30s, 55ºC 1m 30s, 72ºC 1m 30s]; final extension 72ºC for 15m; store at 12ºC.

steps.title: PCR Product Cleanup and Normalization
steps.instruction: Clean PCR products using SPRI beads and normalize concentrations.

substeps.instruction: Equilibrate SPRI bead solution to RT and vortex.
Add 1.5x volume of beads (e.g., 90 µl beads for 60 µl sample), mix 10 times, and incubate for 5 min.
Place on magnet until supernatant clears.
Wash twice with 100 µl freshly prepared 80% EtOH.
Remove from magnet, add 30 µl ddH2O, mix 10 times, and incubate for 5 min.
Place on magnet until supernatant clears and transfer DNA to a new tube.
Measure 1 µl of cleaned product using Qubit HS DNA kit.
Calculate DNA amount to add for each sample based on a similar length distribution.
Add normalization solution at a 1:1 ratio (e.g., 20 µl solution for 20 µl PCR).
Measure concentration of pooled samples, NTC, and positive control using Qubit HS DNA kit.
Add isopropanol at a 1:1 ratio (e.g., 20 µl for 20 µl PCR).
Mix sample, normalization solution, and isopropanol (60 µl total) via pipetting or pulse vortex.
Incubate for 10 min at RT.
Place on magnet for ~5 min, remove supernatant, and wash with 75 µl freshly made 80% EtOH.
Remove residual ethanol and air dry for 30 seconds.
Resuspend each row in 50 µl PCR grade H2O.
Pool all samples (excluding positive and NTC controls) into one 1.5 ml tube and incubate for 5 minutes.
Place on magnet and transfer supernatant to a new tube.

steps.title: End-Repair and A-Tailing
steps.instruction: Prepare the amplicon pool for ligation using a master mix.

substeps.instruction: Prepare master mix per library: 1.5 µl Klenow fragment exo- (5 U/µl), 2 µl T4 PNK (10 U/µl), 0.5 µl dATP (10mM), 4 µl T4 DNA ligase buffer (10x), and 2 µl Reaction booster (Total 10 µl).
Add 10 µl of master mix to each 30 µl amplicon pool, mix by pipetting, and spin down.
Incubate at 37ºC for 30m, then 65ºC for 5m, then store at 4ºC.

steps.title: Ligation of Adapters
steps.instruction: Ligate sequencing adapters to the end-repaired DNA.

substeps.instruction: Spin down Ligation Adapter (LA) and Quick T4 Ligase; place on ice.
Thaw Ligation Buffer (LNB), Elution Buffer (EB), and Short Fragment Buffer (SFB) at RT, then place on ice.
In a 1.5 ml DNA LoBind tube, mix: 60 µl Endrepaired Amplicon pool, 25 µl LNB, 10 µl NEBNext Quick T4 DNA Ligase, and 5 µl LA (Total 100 µl).
Mix by gently pipetting, spin down, and incubate for 10 min at RT.

steps.title: Library Purification
steps.instruction: Purify the ligated library using AMPure XP beads.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend AMPure XP Beads (AXP).
Add 40 µl AXP beads to the reaction, mix by flicking, and incubate for 5 min at RT.
Spin down, place on magnet, and pipette off supernatant.
Wash beads twice with 250 µl Short Fragment Buffer (SFB) and discard supernatant.
Spin down, place on magnet, and remove residual supernatant.
Resuspend pellet in 15 µl Elution Buffer (EB).
Pellet beads on magnet until eluate is clear.
Remove 15 µl of eluate and measure concentration using Qubit HS DNA kit.

steps.title: Library Quantification and Molarity Calculation
steps.instruction: Calculate the molarity of the library to prepare the final loading concentration.

substeps.instruction: Use formula: Molarity (nM) = concentration (ng/µl) / (660 * mean fragment length (bp) * 1e6).
Assume average fragment size for COI and ITS2 is ~500 bp.
Calculate volume for 50 fmol: (50 fmol * 660 * mean fragment length (bp) * 1e6) / concentration (ng/µl).
Prepare 50 fmol in 12 µl of Elution Buffer (EB).

steps.title: Flow Cell Priming
steps.instruction: Prepare and prime the MinION flow cell.

substeps.instruction: Thaw Sequencing Buffer (SB), Library Beads (LIB), Flow Cell Tether (FCT), and Flow Cell Flush (FCF) at RT, then place on ice.
Prepare priming mix: 1170 µl FCF, 5 µl BSA (50 mg/ml), and 30 µl FCT.
Insert flow cell into MinION device and press down firmly.
Open priming port cover clockwise.
Remove air bubbles: Set P1000 to 200 µl, insert tip, and turn wheel to 220-230 µl to draw back 20-30 µl of buffer.
Load 800 µl of priming mix into the priming port and wait 5 min.
Load an additional 200 µl of priming mix into the priming port, avoiding air bubbles.

steps.title: Library Loading and Sequencing
steps.instruction: Load the prepared library onto the flow cell and start the sequencing run.

substeps.instruction: Prepare loading mix in a 1.5 ml DNA LoBind tube: 37.5 µl SB, 25.5 µl LB, and 12 µl DNA library (50 fmol).
Mix the library gently by pipetting just prior to loading.
Lift SpotON sample port cover and add 75 µl of the prepared library dropwise.
Replace SpotON cover and close the priming port.
Place the light shield onto the flow cell.
Run Flow Cell check.
Start MinKnow run with Ligation Sequencing Kit V14 parameters; disable basecalling; select 'include small fragments' if library size is <200bp.
Start the BioScanRT pipeline via the corresponding github repository.
